systemSummary.name: Hatchet Distributed Workflow Orchestrator
systemSummary.description: High-throughput, event-driven task queue and workflow engine orchestrating DAG steps over bidirectional gRPC streams with in-memory slot pool scheduling.

dispatcherService.description: Bi-directional gRPC streaming dispatcher connecting server to distributed worker pools.

schedulingEngine.description: In-memory slot pool scheduler and batch assigner with label affinity.

concurrencyEngine.description: Pluggable workflow and tenant concurrency controller with CancelInProgress / RoundRobin strategies.

tickerDaemon.description: Background ticker managing cron evaluation, worker heartbeats, and step timeouts.

storageLayer.description: PostgreSQL database storing workflow runs, task checkpoints, and durable event logs.

durableExecutionModel.grpcWorkerStreaming: Workers connect to the dispatcher over persistent gRPC streams. Tasks are pushed directly into worker memory buffers.
durableExecutionModel.inMemorySlotPools: Worker capacity is represented as slot pools in memory, enabling sub-millisecond dispatching without database polling bottlenecks.
durableExecutionModel.durableUserEvents: Workflows suspend awaiting external events (ctx.wait_for_event), matched in PostgreSQL with strict workflow and step run scope isolation.
durableExecutionModel.concurrencyFencing: Concurrency limits are enforced across workflow runs, automatically cancelling or queuing tasks according to configured strategies.
durableExecutionModel.orchestratorAuthority: In operator DAGs, the orchestrator task holds sole authority over final workflow status updates, preventing racing child task overwrites.
